findings.description: OPS-HTTP-002 (split from OPS-HTTP-001 AC-9) is in target wave-3 but has no judgement and no mutation-plan row; the plan covers 30 of 31 in-scope requirements. Rescored here as medium 77 -> keep (draft). Add it to per-req-judgement.json and mutation-plan.json before apply.

The judgement (medium 76, ac_verifiability 10, design.md-only evidence) predates the AC rewrite. The new ACs 1-6 each name an in-memory test (byte range at an offset, 101 hand-over, drain loop on an adapter-chosen thread, port 0 -> positive stable port, force-close at the deadline). Rescored high 81, so the plan row (keep/draft, rule 2) is stale and should become evolving (rule 1, auto, dryRun required).

The judgement (medium 75, dependency 11, ac 10) was scored with the docs-example compile rule (old AC-9) inside it. With AC-9 moved to OPS-HTTP-002, AC-1..8 are string-level docs edits checked the way RoutingDocsTest reads docs (NaruServe-api/src/test/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/RoutingDocsTest.java:17,21). Rescored high 86, so the plan row (keep/draft) is stale and should become evolving.

Twelve judgements cite only the design.md decision range 'D-040..D-109, D-392..D-399, D-442' with no line, yet score evidence_strength 15-19 (e.g. FR-HTTP-011 18, FR-HTTP-013 18, FR-HTTP-017/018 18). The path and IDs exist (75 D-lines, D-040/D-109/D-392/D-399/D-442 present), so this is not CRITICAL. But one shared, unlined decision-range citation does not support near-top evidence scores. Cite the specific D-line (e.g. design.md:82-83 for D-106/D-107) or lower to about 14-15. Labels would not change, since every affected score is at least 81 and stays at 80 or more after -3.

No declared depends_on cycle exists across the 31 requirements (DFS over the trace tables). There is an implicit test-time loop, though. FR-HTTP-001 depends_on IR-HTTP-004, and IR-HTTP-004 AC-1/2/3/5/6 are verified only with FR-HTTP-001's in-memory adapter, so the two must land in one step.

All 31 requirements are Status=planned and Stability=draft, matching the plan's current_stability, so there is no status conflict. The stale depends_on row to discarded CON-ROUTE-001 (Status discarded, Stability evolving) remains next to the CON-ROUTE-006 successor row. It is already recorded as a drift candidate in synthesis.json and does not block.

The Tags feasibility:* values disagree with the scores: IR-HTTP-004 is tagged medium (now high 81), OPS-HTTP-001 is tagged high (judged medium 75, now high 86), and OPS-HTTP-002 is tagged high (rescored medium 77). Tags do not drive the mapping, but they should be refreshed with the final judgement.
The trace rows to DocsExamplesCompileTest (two paths) stay on OPS-HTTP-001 although the rule moved to OPS-HTTP-002. Implementation Notes record this as superseded. These rows are informational only.

ac_verifiability 14 is slightly generous: AC-1 is a long descriptive list checked by docs text assertions. AC-3 is crisp (exactly one (미확정) line naming use(middleware); routing.md currently still has markers at lines 21, 72, 127 and 155), so 13 would be fair. The label does not change.
